answer: The pearl counter is kept in orchard and marble publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 41 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An farming party therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 41 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The attacker spends 221 dollars and 20 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
